mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(hd.created_at,'%m%d') date, avg(hrd.bpm) bpm FROM health_data hd LEFT JOIN heart_rate_data hrd ON hd.record_id = hrd.record_id WHERE hd.user_id = #{userId} AND hd.data_type = 'HEART_RATE' AND hd.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(hd.created_at, '%m%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(hd.created_at, '%m%d') ASC;

SELECT bl.total_cholesterol mmol FROM health_data hd JOIN blood_lipid_data bl ON hd.record_id = bl.record_id WHERE hd.user_id = #{userId} AND hd.data_type = 'BLOOD_LIPID' AND hd.created_at = ( SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM health_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND data_type = 'BLOOD_LIPID' );

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.timestamp,'%m%d') date, avg(s.steps) step, avg(s.calories) calorie FROM step_data s JOIN (SELECT * FROM health_data WHERE data_type = 'STEPS') c ON s.record_id = c.record_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} -- Replace with actual user_id AND c.timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL 40 DAY GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(c.timestamp,'%m%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(c.timestamp,'%m%d') ASC;

SELECT base.date, base.calories, ROUND(base.distance_m/1000, 2) AS distance, IFNULL(daily_hr.avg_heart_rate, 90) AS bpm FROM ( SELECT DATE(hd.timestamp) AS date, SUM(sd.calories) AS calories, SUM(sd.distance_m) AS distance_m FROM health_data hd JOIN step_data sd ON hd.record_id = sd.record_id WHERE hd.user_id = #{userId} AND hd.data_type = 'STEPS' GROUP BY DATE(hd.timestamp) ORDER BY DATE(hd.timestamp) DESC LIMIT 7 -- 只获取最近的7条记录 ) AS base LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(hd.timestamp) AS date, AVG(hr.bpm) AS avg_heart_rate FROM health_data hd JOIN heart_rate_data hr ON hd.record_id = hr.record_id WHERE hd.user_id = #{userId} AND hd.data_type = 'HEART_RATE' GROUP BY DATE(hd.timestamp) ) AS daily_hr ON base.date = daily_hr.date ORDER BY base.date DESC;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO target_step (user_id, targetstep) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetStep}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE targetstep = VALUES(targetstep)
INSERT INTO sport_time_data (user_id, sporttime) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sportTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sporttime = VALUES(sporttime)
INSERT INTO target_heat_data (user_id, targetheat) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetHeat}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE targetheat = VALUES(targetheat)
